work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCXXXVII, addressed to the bishop of Orvieto (LF63684–63685), commissions him to authorise the perpetual emphyteusis of the hospital's lands at S. Vito, S. Venanzio and elsewhere to the marquis Paolo Antonio Viti for 412 scudi a year, and ends with its own 27 May 1834 closing at LF63824 (OCR mati for maii), before numeral CCCXXXVIII at LF63827. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF63688–63688; the source closing at LF63821–63824 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima septima mati millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno quarto. LF63705 (1 Ex Bullario Romano.) is its own provenance note, excluded with a corner speck (LF63708 =). Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
